reason: B is the better proposal because it specifies W content, temperature, quantitative outcomes, controls, and a falsification experiment, while its single-phase solid-solution mechanism is more plausible than A’s unsupported assumption of coherent W-rich precipitates. It remains incomplete because it does not directly test thermal conductivity or decisively distinguish solid-solution strengthening from grain-growth effects, and it provides no supporting prior-HEA evidence.
